title: Two Laredo men arrested on drug charges after counterfeit $20 bills reported at businesses, police say
excerpt: Laredo police arrested two men on October 27 after a report of counterfeit $20 bills at businesses led officers to search an apartment, according to KGNS.
content:
Laredo police arrested two men on October 27 after a report of counterfeit $20 bills being used at businesses led officers to obtain a search warrant for an apartment, according to KGNS.

Jesus Gutierrez, 36, of Laredo, was arrested on three counts of drug possession, KGNS reported. Miguel Cisneros, 38, of Laredo, was arrested on charges of drug possession, theft and tampering with physical evidence, according to KGNS.

The reporting reviewed did not specify the type or amount of drugs involved, the businesses involved, or the apartment’s location. The men are presumed innocent until proven guilty, and the charges described are allegations.

Sources:

  • KGNS, "2 face drug charges after counterfeit bills used at Laredo businesses," November 2, 2026
